detail.title: EWR1080 Ear Wax Removal Tool with 1080P Camera
detail.overview: The Ant Esports EWR1080 is a smart ear cleaning tool with a built-in 1080P HD camera that streams a live, wide-angle view of the ear canal straight to a connected smartphone, taking the guesswork out of everyday ear cleaning. Six interchangeable soft silicone ear tips let you match the fit and angle to your ear for safer, more comfortable cleaning, while bright built-in LEDs keep the picture clear even in low light. An IP67 waterproof build makes it easy to rinse clean after use, and a 350mAh rechargeable battery delivers roughly 90 minutes of continuous use with USB-C charging. Simple WiFi pairing connects it instantly to the companion app on both Android and iOS, so you can see exactly what you're doing every step of the way.
